battle.name: 胡柳陂之戰
battle.brief: 後梁乾德六年閏七月，晉王李存勖在商丘胡柳陂迎擊段凝、朱友珪的援軍，騎戰中一度受挫、李嗣源重傷，終以精騎突陣取勝，梁軍大潰，潞州之圍遂解。卡面的埃及月牙劍早於此役一千八百餘年而廢用，是單刃彎刀的最早典範；五代騎兵手中已是環首直刀與初出的彎刀。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場戰爭是後梁與後唐前身晉軍在河南東部的一場決定性野戰，交戰地點是汴河（隋唐漕運的通濟渠）兩岸的胡柳陂，位於宋州商丘以北數十里的寧陵一帶，縱是柳樹成行的澤陂泥淖。後梁一方由北面行營招討使段凝領軍，齊王朱友珪在側策應，後梁末帝朱友貞坐鎮汴州，節制中原諸州、禁軍與漕運；梁朝佔有汴州、鄴城、宋州、滑州、曹州一線的河南平原，握有五代最完整的朝廷、鹽鐵與漕運體系，是名分上的正統。後唐一方其實是李克用一手帶出的沙陀騎兵集團：乾德三年李克用死後，養子李存勖承晉王位與河東兵權，以趙州為騎兵東進的基地，麾下有李嗣源、周德威、史建瑭等宿將，騎兵為骨幹、州鎮鄉兵為輔。場外第三方同樣要緊：北面契丹與幽州盧龍軍節度使劉仁恭在燕雲一線咬住梁軍，河北諸鎮多持觀望；梁軍一旦久滯河南，契丹便可趁虛窺伺幽州，所以段凝不能久屯不進，一戰失利就沒有第二次整軍的餘裕。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive field engagement in eastern Henan between the Later Liang, also known as Zhu Liang, and the forces that would become the Later Tang. It was fought on both banks of the Bian River, the Tongji Canal of Sui and Tang times, at Huliupo, a stretch of willow thicket and marshy ground lying a few dozen li north of the prefectural seat Songzhou, modern Shangqiu, and close to Ningling. The Later Liang side fought under the Prince of Qi Zhu Yougui with Duan Ning, Commander of the Northern Front, holding the field army; Emperor Zhu Youzhen sat at Bianzhou, modern Kaifeng, controlling the circuits of the Central Plain, the imperial guard and the canal transport. The Liang held the whole Henan plain from Bianzhou through Ye, Songzhou, Huazhou and Caozhou, and commanded the most complete court, salt, iron and grain transport apparatus of any regime in the era, being the orthodox dynasty in name. The Later Tang side was in fact the Shatuo cavalry group built up by Li Keyong. After Li Keyong died in 915, his adopted son Li Cunxu inherited the title Prince of Jin and the military power of Hedong, and used Zhaozhou as the base for cavalry operations to the east, with veteran commanders such as Li Siyuan, Zhou Dewei and Shi Jianhuang at his back, cavalry forming the core and locally levied troops from the circuits the auxiliaries. Third parties outside the field mattered just as much: to the north, the Khitan and Liu Rengong, Military Governor of Lulong, were biting at Liang troops along the Yan-Yun frontier, while most of the Hebei circuits watched and waited. Once the Liang army dawdled in Henan, the Khitan could have probed Youzhou, so Duan Ning could not camp long in the field, and after a single defeat he had no margin left to rally and fight again.
people: 全場的樞紐是晉王李存勖。此時他三十歲上下，剛從養父李克用手上接過河東與河北的兵權，名義上卻仍面對一個制度更完整、國力更厚的後梁。他不願在潞州城下曠日持久地磨下去，趁梁軍主力南下，寧可把宿敵放到開闊地上一決雌雄。李嗣源是晉軍的實際統兵主將：此役他身先士卒，直衝梁軍鋒線，被兩翼騎兵合圍，戰馬中流矢、人中數箭，幾乎不能軍，仍扶督軍陣掩護中軍重整，是全場最險關頭的一根支柱。梁方主帥段凝是後梁末年最能打的將領，出身兗州，以鎮撫驕兵、百戰宿將而位至樞密，統著梁朝最後一批能打的精騎；齊王朱友珪在旁策應，此人曾弒父篡位，於梁廷內部早有惡名，軍中畏其請而不服其能。梁廷還有末帝朱友貞與樞密院、禁軍之間的暗中掣肘；晉方則以周德威的悲劇作襯——他正是在此前攻鄴時因舟師被焚而陣亡，這一戰晉軍失去了最善於野戰的老帥，陣中不得不再倚重李存勖本人的臨機決斷。
peopleEn: The pivot of the whole battle was the Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu. He was around thirty years old, having just taken over the military power of Hedong and Hebei from his adoptive father Li Keyong, and he was still in name facing a Later Liang with a more complete institutional structure and greater resources. He did not want to grind on in front of Liuzhou for months on end; with the Liang main army moving south he preferred to settle the matter with his enemy on open ground. Li Siyuan was the actual commander of the Jin field force. In this battle he led from the front, charged straight into the Liang spearhead, was surrounded by cavalry from both wings, had his horse hit by arrows and his body struck by many shafts, was near the point of being carried away, and yet still propped himself up to hold the line and cover the reorganisation of the central army, the single pillar in the most dangerous moment of the fight. On the Liang side the commander, Duan Ning, was the most capable general of the late Liang, a native of Yanzhou who rose to the position of Privy Councillor through years of campaigning and the management of insubordinate troops, and he commanded the last body of effective cavalry the Liang possessed; the Prince of Qi Zhu Yougui supported him on the flank, a man who had murdered his father and seized the throne, long hated inside the Liang court, feared by the army and never really obeyed. The Liang court also suffered from open friction between Emperor Zhu Youzhen, the Privy Council and the imperial guard. On the Jin side the tragedy of Zhou Dewei frames the whole campaign: he had been killed in the earlier assault on Ye, when his river fleet was burned, so this battle was fought without the ablest old general of the Jin army for open battle, and the ranks had to lean instead on Li Cunxu's own decisions on the spot.
kits: 全場交鋒的是五代中原的騎兵與步卒組合，不是冷兵器時代的通用步戰。晉軍骨幹是李克用留下的沙陀精騎，人數不眾而裝備精：騎士著皮甲或札甲，頭戴兜鍪、配護臂，佩環首刀或直刀（刀身修直而略帶弧度，柄首加環，單刃或微兩刃，斬馬足、砍鎧皆宜），近身有長柄刀與馬槊，馬上用角木為骨、桑皮為腹的弓與箭，另有較輕的標槊供高速衝鋒與超越射擊。梁軍裝備與晉軍大同小異，段凝的精騎重甲而重速度，配傍盾與長槊，以密集楔形衝撞破陣。五代正處於彎刀（俗稱馬刀）成熟的節點，單刃、弧背、圓環首而無鐔，砍入不折，與直刀並行。卡面的埃及月牙劍正是這一族形制的最早典範：古埃及的外彎單刃青銅劍，比本役早了一千八百餘年，砍入敵體不易卡死、不必拔劍再斬，弧形外凸的刃更省力。它本身不可能出現在九一八年的汴河戰場，那時它在近東與地中海早已廢棄數百年；但它的設計邏輯經波斯、中亞一路東傳，在唐代凝成儀刀直刀，五代變為彎刀馬刀，最終定型為宋金以降的斬馬刀。營具與雜械同樣要緊：鞍韉、馬鐙、籠頭，運糧的車與船、糧秣、薪草、飲水、帳幕、鼓角與號角；攻營器械有拒馬、鹿角、塹壕、壘壁、雲梯、巢車、飛石砲與撞車，只是此役以野戰為主，這些器械多半留在後方營壘待命。
kitsEn: The clash was fought by the mixed cavalry and infantry of the Central Plain in the Five Dynasties, not by the massed foot combat of the general cold-weapon age. The backbone of the Jin army was the Shatuo cavalry left by Li Keyong: not numerous, but well equipped. Riders wore leather or lamellar armour, with helmets and arm guards, and carried ring-pommel swords or straight swords whose blades were long and slightly curved, with a ring at the pommel, single-edged or nearly so, equally at home cutting a horse's leg or biting through armour. At close quarters they had long-handled sabres and long lances; on horseback they used bows built of horn and sinew on a mulberry core, with arrows, plus lighter javelins for fast charge and shooting at range. The Liang equipment was much the same, but Duan Ning's heavy cavalry was armoured for impact and speed, using large shields and long spears, crushing the enemy in a dense wedge. The Five Dynasties stand exactly at the point where the curved sabre, popularly called the madao, matured: single-edged, with a curved back, a ring pommel and no guard, which would not snap when it bit in, worn alongside the straight sword. The Egyptian khopesh on this card is the earliest exemplar of exactly that family of form: the outward-curved single-edged bronze sword of ancient Egypt, older than this battle by more than eighteen centuries, which did not jam in a body and did not have to be pulled back out to strike again, its convex edge making the blow easier. It could not of course be present on the Bian River field in 918, having been abandoned in the Near East and the Mediterranean for centuries; but its design logic travelled east through Persia and Central Asia, hardened into the straight ceremonial dao of the Tang, turned into the curved sabre of the Five Dynasties, and finally settled as the horse-cutting dao of Song, Jin and later. Camp equipment and tools mattered as much: saddles and girths, stirrups, bridles, the carts and boats that carried grain, provisions, firewood and water, tents, drums, horns and bugles. For storming a camp there were cheval-de-frise, caltrops, ditches, ramparts, scaling ladders, observation towers, stone-throwing engines and battering rams, but since this was a battle in the open, most of that gear stayed behind in the fortified camps.
tactics: 戰場在汴河北岸與澤陂交錯的柳林之間，泥淖處處，騎兵一旦離開堤道與硬地就容易陷在軟地裡，因此雙方都把主力壓在汴河兩側的堤道與高地上。梁軍以精騎為前鋒、前後列陣，前有飛龍、飛虎之號的突騎，兩翼配控弦步騎，重點在正面硬撞；晉軍則以步兵結陣在前、騎兵分置兩翼，等梁軍先動。接觸是反覆試探：晉軍先遣精騎挑戰，梁軍按兵不動，待其氣衰，晉軍才令中軍全線展開。第一輪交換是晉軍失利，李嗣源率精騎直突梁軍鋒線，被梁軍左右兩翼騎兵合圍，箭傷遍身，戰馬中矢，部眾被切斷退路，中軍一度退卻。轉折在李存勖收攏散卒、重整中軍之後：他不再與梁軍比硬碰硬，而是集中千餘精騎為一隊，瞅準梁軍指揮中樞與陣腳銜接處突入，一路以騎隊切割梁軍橫陣，一路沿汴河兩岸包抄斷其退路；梁軍前鋒一被切斷便成潰散，段凝收殘部夜退回鄴。追擊中梁軍被逼向汴水，士卒相蹈藉，棄下的甲兵、弓弩、旗幟沿途委積，窄道上行列互相擠壓，展開不開。
tacticsEn: The field lay among the willows and the ponds north of the Bian River, with soft ground everywhere; cavalry that left the levee road and hard ground risked bogging down, so both sides pressed their main bodies onto the raised banks and firm ground along the canal. The Liang deployed its heavy cavalry as a spearhead in depth, with assault troops designated Flying Dragon and Flying Tiger in front and bowmen and foot on the wings, putting the weight of the attack on a frontal collision; the Jin formed foot in front and posted cavalry on the wings, waiting for the Liang to move first. Contact came by repeated testing: the Jin first sent light cavalry out to challenge, the Liang stood still, and only when the attackers' momentum had faded did the Jin central army deploy along the whole front. The first exchange went against the Jin. Li Siyuan led heavy cavalry straight at the Liang spearhead, was enveloped by cavalry from both wings, took arrow wounds all over, had his horse shot, and had his troops cut off from the line of retreat, so that the central army gave ground for a time. The turning point came after Li Cunxu gathered the stragglers and re-formed the central army. He no longer tried to match the Liang in a direct collision, but concentrated more than a thousand picked riders into one body, struck at the point where the Liang command centre met the joint of its line, drove one force of horse to cut the Liang front in two and sent another along both banks of the Bian to seal the retreat. Once the Liang spearhead was cut off it dissolved; Duan Ning gathered what was left and withdrew by night towards Ye. In the pursuit the Liang were driven towards the water, men trampling one another, the discarded armour, bows and banners piling up along the road, and on the narrow tracks the files pressed against each other so that no line could be opened out.
data: 作戰時間一般繫於後梁乾德六年閏七月，落在公元九一八年之末至九一九年，通常記作九一九年八月。兵力方面，兩家正史所記多作梁軍七萬、晉軍五萬，合計逾十萬，是五代前中期中原規模最大的一次野戰；史書數字往往有誇大與重複計算，實際當量當有出入，但量級無疑在數萬之數。戰果方面，斬首與俘獲以萬計，晉軍收繳戰馬數千匹，梁軍被追殺、陷水與散失者數萬，棄置的甲兵、弓弩、旗幟沿汴河道委積數十里。晉軍自身代價也不輕，李嗣源重傷，諸將多中矢，戰後收兵疲憊，無力乘勢直取汴州。距離與補給上，胡柳陂距宋州商丘約數十里，汴州在西北方向約二百餘里，潞州在上黨東北方向的邊緣，官道距離約四百餘里；梁軍自鄴城南下須仰給汴州漕運，晉軍則靠河東與河北兩路輸送，一場會戰的勝負，直接決定兩百里內運河的船與糧歸誰使用。
dataEn: The fighting is generally dated to the leap seventh month of the sixth year of Qiande in the Later Liang, which falls at the turn of 918 and 919 and is usually given as August 919. On strength, both the Later Liang and Later Tang histories commonly give some seventy thousand Liang troops against about fifty thousand Jin troops, more than a hundred thousand in all, which makes this the largest open battle in the Central Plain before the middle of the Five Dynasties. Historical numbers are often exaggerated or double-counted, so the true strength must have differed, but the order of magnitude is certainly in the tens of thousands. As to results, the killed and captured are counted by the ten thousand, the Jin gathered several thousand horses, the Liang lost men to pursuit, drowning and dispersal in the tens of thousands, and the discarded armour, bows and banners lay piled along the Bian for tens of li. The Jin paid too: Li Siyuan was badly wounded, many officers were hit by arrows, and the army was too exhausted after the action to press on to Bianzhou at once. On distances and supply, Huliupo lay a few dozen li from the seat of Songzhou at modern Shangqiu, Bianzhou lay some two hundred li to the north-west, and Liuzhou sat on the far side of Shangdang to the north-east, roughly four hundred li away by the post road. The Liang army marching down from Ye drew its food from the canal transport of Bianzhou, while the Jin drew on two lines, from Hedong and from Hebei; the outcome of a single field action therefore decided who would own the boats and the grain on two hundred li of canal.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因有三層。第一層是上黨之地：潞州自乾德三年起被晉軍圍住，既是後梁的西北屏障，也是晉軍南下河南的跳板，圍城已逾兩年，糧道與援軍成了唯一的變數。第二層是後梁自身的結構性困境：朱溫死後宮廷政變頻仍，末帝朱友貞與其兄朱友珪、與樞密院、與禁軍彼此猜忌，主力將領段凝雖握兵權卻得不到後方充分支持，既要解潞州之圍，又要提防契丹與幽州乘虛而入，救兵成了不能久屯、又不能不打的任務。第三層是晉軍的戰略需求：李存勖在周德威陣亡、舟師被焚之後失去控制汴河水面的力量，若再在城下與梁軍主力相持，晉軍會被拖入更難的消耗；此時梁軍主力南下渡汴，晉軍得到一個在野戰中以騎兵破敵的窗口，遂主動出城，在胡柳陂迎擊。
causeEn: The war had three layers of cause. The first was the ground of Shangdang: Liuzhou, under siege by the Jin since the third year of Qiande, was both the Liang's shield in the north-west and the springboard for a Jin advance into Henan. The siege had already run past two years, and the relief army was the only variable left. The second was the structural difficulty of the Later Liang itself. After Zhu Wen's death the court was convulsed by coups; Emperor Zhu Youzhen, his brother Zhu Yougui, the Privy Council and the imperial guard all mistrusted one another, and although Duan Ning held the field command he could not get full support from the rear: he had both to lift the siege of Liuzhou and to keep the Khitan and Youzhou from moving on the Liang while he did it, so that the relief force could neither stay long in one place nor refuse to fight. The third was the Jin's own strategic need. After Zhou Dewei's death and the burning of his river fleet, Li Cunxu had lost the force that could control the water of the Bian; to keep besieging Liuzhou in front of the Liang main army would have dragged the Jin into a worse war of attrition. With the Liang main force moving south across the river, the Jin was given its chance to break the enemy with cavalry in the open, so it came out to meet them at Huliupo.
impact: 胡柳陂一勝扭轉了河南的局勢。上黨歸晉，梁失去西北屏障，晉軍得以據險東出，汴州與曹、滑、宋諸州暴露在晉軍騎兵的攻程之內，梁朝倚以自固的河東、河北、河南三角中最關鍵的一角被切斷。對後唐而言，此役把李存勖從守方統帥推成攻方樞紐，雖然他自己也付出李嗣源重傷、諸將多創的代價，勝勢卻已在握；四年後他趁梁廷內亂奇襲汴州，滅後梁，建立後唐。對後梁而言，七萬精騎的損失與段凝的敗績，使這位名將在朝中失去兵權，退居汴京的段凝與部將、禁軍的衝突加劇，其後的宮變中段凝與朱友珪相繼身死，梁的內部秩序崩解得更早。戰術層面上，這一場以騎兵突陣分割敵陣、逼敵於水際潰散的打法，為宋初的騎戰留下了直接範本。
impactEn: The victory at Huliupo turned the situation in Henan upside down. Shangdang went to the Jin, the Liang lost its shield in the north-west, the Jin held the heights from which it could strike east, and Bianzhou with the circuits of Cao, Hua and Song lay within reach of Jin horse; the corner of the Hedong-Hebei-Henan triangle on which the Liang had based itself was cut away. For the Later Tang the battle turned Li Cunxu from a defensive commander into the hinge of an offensive, and though it cost him a badly wounded Li Siyuan and many wounded officers, the advantage was already in his hands; four years later he struck at Bianzhou during the Liang's internal convulsions, destroyed the Later Liang and founded the Later Tang. For the Later Liang the loss of the seven wan strong cavalry and Duan Ning's defeat stripped that famous general of his command; Duan Ning, now living in Bianzhou, collided more sharply with his own subordinates and the imperial guard, and in the palace coup that followed both he and Zhu Yougui were killed, so that the Liang's internal order came apart even earlier. At the level of tactics, a battle in which cavalry punched through the enemy line, split it and drowned it at the water's edge left a direct model for the mounted warfare of early Song.
result: 梁軍大敗，段凝收殘兵退保鄴城，齊王朱友珪先行退避，李存勖取得一場乾淨的野戰勝利。李嗣源雖重傷，猶能整軍，說明晉軍的指揮系統在重擊之下仍能運作。梁軍北面行營的精銳在此役折損大半，段凝名望雖重，兵權卻一步步被削去；晉軍雖未一舉攻破汴州，四年後的汴京之役，仍是由同一支沙陀騎兵完成的終局。圍困潞州的晉軍得到解圍之機，上黨守軍在絕望中出降，晉軍入據潞州，取得河南西北的戰略支點。但晉軍並未乘勢追到汴州城下：久戰疲憊、糧道未及接續、盛夏水患與泥淖限制騎兵馳騁，使其必須先整頓後方再圖進取。這一役的意義不在速決，而在於雙方實力與士氣此消彼長：梁朝在河南的野戰主力喪失，晉朝則在李克用死後第一場硬仗中站穩，最終把後梁逼入內亂，四年後走向覆亡。
resultEn: The Liang army was beaten badly; Duan Ning gathered the remnants and fell back on Ye, the Prince of Qi Zhu Yougui withdrew first, and Li Cunxu won a clean victory in the field. Li Siyuan, badly wounded as he was, could still straighten the ranks, which showed that the Jin command system still worked under a heavy blow. The elite of the Liang Northern Front had been broken in this battle; Duan Ning's fame remained but his command was stripped away piece by piece, and although the Jin did not storm Bianzhou at once, the final reckoning four years later was still carried out by the same Shatuo cavalry. The Jin besiegers of Liuzhou were relieved, the Liang garrison in Shangdang surrendered in despair, and the Jin took Liuzhou, gaining a strategic foothold in the north-west of Henan. The Jin did not press on to the walls of Bianzhou. Exhausted by long fighting, with the supply line not yet joined up, and checked by summer floods and soft ground that hindered the cavalry, they had to reform and re-supply before advancing again. The meaning of the battle lay not in a quick decision but in the balance of strength and morale: the Liang lost the field army on which its position in Henan rested, while the Jin stood firm in the first hard fight after Li Keyong's death, and in the end drove the Later Liang into internal collapse and to its destruction four years later.
